title: Noisy meeting with final decisions
attack: filler and reversals around key facts

messages.content: Okay random notes first: coffee budget is irrelevant, ignore the joke about migrating everything to spreadsheets. Real decision: Token Optimizer v3 benchmark must finish before semantic compressor design starts. Someone said Jun 20, then corrected it: final benchmark deadline is Jun 25. Owner Chen. Need at least 30 real-world cases. Budget is still $900, not the joking $9,000 number.
Final: Chen owns Token Optimizer v3 benchmark, deadline Jun 25, 30 real-world cases, $900 budget, before semantic compressor design.
